name.zh: 8-bit 紅白機・霸王之路主將
name.en: 8-bit Famicom, Path of the Hegemon general

blurb.zh: 《三國志 霸王之路》裡的主將造型：同一張 8-bit 臉，換上漢代將軍的冠、明光鎧與披風。
blurb.en: The main-general look from Three Kingdoms: Path of the Hegemon: the same 8-bit face in a Han general's cap, mirror armour and cape.

name.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

blurb.zh: 主畫風。仿紅白機《三國志 霸王の大陸》的 8-bit 頭像：48×56、粗黑線、平塗兩三階陰影，只用紅白機標準色盤，每 16×16 格一組三色（全圖最多四組），眼白、唇色等小細節用精靈疊上；配 16×24 的紅白機小人，正面與側面兩格步行，孩子明顯比大人矮。
blurb.en: The main style. 8-bit Famicom portraits in the manner of 三國志 霸王の大陸: 48×56, bold black lines, flat two- or three-step shading, only colours from the NES palette with one 3-colour set per 16×16 area (at most four sets), and small sprite overlays for eye whites and lips; plus 16×24 NES field sprites with a two-frame front and side walk, the children clearly shorter than their parents.

name.zh: HD-2D 可愛版（八方旅人風）

blurb.zh: 前一版主畫風。柔和溫暖的 HD-2D 大頭像，加上圓臉小黑眼、四方向行走的 Q 版角色；一家人同一畫布、同一條地平線，身高一看就懂。
blurb.en: The previous main style. Warm, soft HD-2D portraits and round-faced sprites with small dark eyes that walk in four directions; the whole family shares one canvas and baseline, so heights read at a glance.

name.zh: 霸王の大陸 × 像素棒球

blurb.zh: 16-bit 三國策略遊戲式的寫實側光半身頭像，配像素棒球遊戲式的 Q 版全身。
blurb.en: Side-lit 16-bit Three Kingdoms strategy bust portraits with pixel-baseball chibis.

blurb.zh: 細緻柔和的大頭像，加上約三頭身、柔和陰影、小黑眼的角色點陣。
blurb.en: A detailed painterly portrait and a soft-shaded sprite about three heads tall with tiny dark eyes.

blurb.zh: 柔和漸層的 48×48 選單頭像，加上 16×24 四方向行走的地圖角色。
blurb.en: A soft-shaded 48×48 menu portrait and a 16×24 field sprite walking in four directions.

name.zh: GBA 戰棋（聖火降魔錄風）

blurb.zh: 明亮賽璐璐上色、銳利輪廓的 16 色頭像，加上厚實的戰鬥角色。
blurb.en: A bright cel-shaded 16-colour portrait with crisp outlines and a chunky battle sprite.

blurb.zh: 每個角色 3 色加透明的 16×16 小人與兩格步行，配簡單的頭像視窗。
blurb.en: 16×16 sprites in 3 colours plus transparency with a two-frame walk, and a simple portrait window.

name.zh: 8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

blurb.zh: 龍門人物照《霸王之路》的水準重畫：頭像有臉、髮、衣、兵器的明暗層次，深色漸層背景，小黑眼；16×24 小人用兩層精靈、頭髮與帽子和頭像一致，加上背面行走。
blurb.en: The Longmen cast redrawn to the Path of the Hegemon bar: portraits with shading on face, hair, cloth and gear over a dark dithered backdrop, tiny dark eyes; 16×24 sprites in two sprite layers whose hair and headgear match the portrait, now with a back-view walk.

title.en: The strategist who builds fire rafts

bio.zh: 一家之主，船匠兼工程師，也是隊伍裡的軍師。圓眼鏡在船難裡裂了一角，扳手卻一直插在腰間。他看得懂江東的船，也看得懂風向，第一個想到把整條船變成火龍衝進敵陣。
bio.en: Father of the family: shipwright, engineer and the party's strategist. His round glasses cracked in the wreck, but the wrench never left his belt. He reads Jiangdong hulls as well as the wind, and was the first to think of turning a whole boat into a fire dragon.

bio.zh: 兩個孩子的母親，船上的領航員，也是醫者。看星象、讀天氣、包紮傷口，樣樣在行。腰間的藥草袋總是鼓鼓的，她說明天會下雨，明天就會下雨。
bio.en: Mother of the two boys, the ship's navigator and its healer: stars, weather and wounds are all hers to read. Her herb pouch is always full, and when she says it will rain tomorrow, it rains.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
HD-2D 可愛版（八方旅人風）
SNES JRPG（FF6 風）
霸王の大陸 × 像素棒球

bio.zh: 十歲的哥哥，勇敢又熱心。背著小木盾、拿著木棍，總是站在弟弟前面，大聲喊話把壞人引到自己身上。笑起來露出缺了一顆的門牙。
bio.en: The ten-year-old big brother, brave and warm-hearted. With his little wooden shield and stick he always stands in front of his brother, shouting to draw trouble onto himself. His grin shows a missing tooth.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
HD-2D 可愛版（八方旅人風）
GBA 戰棋（聖火降魔錄風）
霸王の大陸 × 像素棒球

bio.zh: 八歲的弟弟，一家人裡最小也最快。眼尖手巧，背著小布包、拿著彈弓，地圖上的祕密總是他先發現；頭上兩個小髻是媽媽每天早上替他綁的。
bio.en: The eight-year-old little brother, smallest and quickest of the family. Sharp eyes, quick hands, a satchel and a slingshot: he finds the map's secrets first. Mum ties his two little hair buns every morning.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
HD-2D 可愛版（八方旅人風）
8-bit 紅白機（勇者鬥惡龍風）
霸王の大陸 × 像素棒球

bio.zh: 河東解良人，與劉備、張飛結為兄弟。赤面長髯，綠巾綠袍，手持青龍偃月刀。重義守信，千里尋兄的故事流傳至今。
bio.en: A man of Xieliang in Hedong, sworn brother of Liu Bei and Zhang Fei. Red-faced and long-bearded, in a green headscarf and robe, he carries the Green Dragon Crescent Blade. His loyalty is remembered in the tale of riding a thousand li to rejoin his brother.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
霸王の大陸 × 像素棒球

title.en: The Yellow Turban Rebellion - Yellow Turban captain

bio.zh: 黃巾軍的頭目，頭綁黃巾、眉上一道疤，帶著一群拿長槍的農民兵。霸王之路的第一戰，新任主將的試刀石。
bio.en: A Yellow Turban captain with a yellow head-cloth and a scar over one brow, leading peasant spearmen. The first battle of the road, where a new general proves himself.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The Battle of Guangzong - General of the Earth

bio.zh: 黃巾三兄弟之一，自稱地公將軍。黃道袍、長黑鬚，手舉紅字符紙，據說能呼風喚雨、撒豆成兵。
bio.en: One of the three Yellow Turban brothers, the self-styled General of the Earth. A yellow Daoist robe, a long black beard and a red-script talisman held high; they say he can call wind and rain.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.zh: 汜水關・董卓麾下猛將

bio.zh: 董卓帳下的猛將，滿臉濃鬍、紅纓鐵盔、一把大刀。守在汜水關前，連斬聯軍數將。
bio.en: Dong Zhuo's fierce champion: a bushy beard, an iron helmet with a red plume and a broad dao. He holds Sishui Pass and has cut down several allied officers.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The Shouchun Campaign - Yuan Shu's general

bio.zh: 袁術手下第一大將，紫纓鐵盔、面色冷峻，使一把三尖兩刃刀。守著壽春，一步也不退。
bio.en: Yuan Shu's foremost general: a purple-plumed iron helmet, a stern clean face and a three-pointed double-edged blade. He holds Shouchun and will not give a step.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The Siege of Baima - Champion of Hebei

bio.zh: 袁紹帳下的河北名將，翼盔紅纓、方正大鬍、青銅金甲，手提大刀，是袁軍兩大猛將之一。
bio.en: One of Yuan Shao's two great champions of Hebei: a winged helmet with a red tassel, a square heavy beard, bronze-gold armour and a great dao.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The Battle of Yanjin - Champion of Hebei

bio.zh: 與顏良齊名的袁軍猛將，尖頂鐵盔、齜牙怒目、一把長槍。性子比顏良更兇，一心要替兄弟報仇。
bio.en: Yan Liang's equal in Yuan Shao's army: a spiked iron helmet, bared teeth, glaring eyes and a spear. Fiercer than his comrade, and set on avenging him.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The Battle of Hefei - Cao Cao's great general

bio.zh: 曹操帳下名將，白纓藍盔、短鬚沉穩。以少擊眾、臨危不亂，打得敵軍聞名喪膽。
bio.en: One of Cao Cao's finest generals: a blue helmet with a white plume, a neat beard and a steady gaze. Calm under pressure, he wins against the odds.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 曹操的族弟兼大將，左眼戴著黑眼罩、滿臉黑鬍，鐵甲藍纓。脾氣剛烈，衝鋒總在最前面。
bio.en: Cao Cao's kinsman and general, with a black patch over his left eye, a full black beard and iron armour with blue lacing. Hot-tempered, always first into the charge.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 天下無雙的飛將：紫金冠插兩根雉雞翎、金甲紅袍，手持方天畫戟。霸王之路的最後一關，等在虎牢關上。
bio.en: The peerless Flying General: a gold crown with two pheasant feathers, gold armour, a red robe and the Sky Piercer halberd. The last battle of the road, waiting on Hulao Pass.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 龍門刀莊的長子，背著一把舊環首刀離家闖蕩。話不多，眉眼總是往前看；深藍長袍、藍色頭帶，頭帶的尾巴在風裡飛。他相信再遠的路，都是從第一刀開始的。
bio.en: Elder son of the Longmen Saber Manor, who left home with an old ring-pommel saber on his back. He says little and always looks ahead, in an indigo robe with a blue headband whose ties fly in the wind. However long the road, he believes it begins with the first cut.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

bio.zh: 奕叡的弟弟，從小不愛拿刀，只愛踢球。紅頭帶、朱紅短褂，右嘴角上方有一顆痣，球從不離腳。看到不公平的事，總是先衝再想。
bio.en: Yi Rui’s little brother, who never cared for blades, only for kicking a ball. Red headband, vermilion jacket, a mole above the right corner of his mouth, and the ball never far from his feet. When he sees something unfair he charges first and thinks later.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

bio.zh: 江湖人稱「暴龍」。銀髮金角，黑金龍鱗袍外披猩紅披風，嘴角總掛著一絲冷笑。不用兵器，只用一雙手掌；出手之前，總要先冷笑三聲。
bio.en: Known on the rivers and lakes as the Tyrant Dragon. Silver hair and golden horns, a black robe worked with gold scales under a crimson cape, and a sneer at one corner of his mouth. He carries no weapon but his palms, and before he strikes he always laughs three cold laughs.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

bio.zh: 十字路口聽雨樓的說書先生。方巾長袖，山羊鬍，醒木一拍，古今江湖的大小消息就從他嘴裡說出來——沒有他不知道的事。
bio.en: The storyteller of the Listening-to-Rain teahouse at the crossroads. Square cap, long sleeves, a little goatee: one clap of his wooden block and every tale of the rivers and lakes, old and new, comes out of his mouth. There is no news he has not heard.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

title.en: Mistress of the Cold River Pavilion

bio.zh: 寒江閣的閣主。高髻銀簪，白衣淡藍，一柄細劍。待人冷淡、疑心很重，劍出時霜飛雪落；但欠下的人情，她一定會還。
bio.en: Mistress of the Cold River Pavilion. A high knot of hair with a silver pin, white over pale blue, and a slender sword. Cool and slow to trust, her sword brings frost and snow when it is drawn; but a debt she owes, she always repays.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

bio.zh: 千佛寺的住持，白眉長鬚，杏黃僧袍外披紅色袈裟，手持禪杖。總是笑瞇瞇的，說起話來慢條斯理；記性卻好得驚人。
bio.en: Abbot of the Thousand Buddhas Temple: white brows and a long white beard, a saffron robe under a red kasaya, a monk’s staff in hand. Always smiling and slow of speech, with a remarkably long memory.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
8-bit 紅白機・龍門新版（試作）

title.en: Chief of the Black Wind Fort

bio.zh: 黑風寨的寨主，虎背熊腰，一臉濃密黑鬍，肩上披著自己獵來的熊皮，手提一根狼牙棒。嗓門大、脾氣粗，可別被他騙了：寨子能在官府眼皮底下撐這麼多年，靠的不只是蠻力。
bio.en: Chief of the Black Wind Fort: broad as a bear, a thick black beard, the hide of a bear he hunted himself over one shoulder and a spiked club in his fist. He is loud and rough, but do not be fooled: a fort does not hold out under the magistrate's nose for so many years on muscle alone.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Second of the Black Wind Fort

bio.zh: 黑風寨的二當家，兩鬢剃得精光，頭頂紮個髮髻；一道長疤從眉梢斜劈到下巴，誰問起來歷，他就把大刀往地上一頓。話少，下手狠，寨裡的規矩都由他來管。
bio.en: Second chief of the Black Wind Fort, his temples shaved bare and a topknot on his crown. A long scar runs from his brow down to his jaw; ask him where it came from and he only sets his broad dao down hard on the ground. He says little, strikes hard, and keeps the fort's rules.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Errand Boy of the Black Wind Fort

bio.zh: 黑風寨的小嘍囉，瘦得像根竹竿，一笑就露出兩顆大門牙。衣服補了又補，腰間別一把短刀；眼珠子滴溜溜地轉，哪邊有便宜就往哪邊靠。跑得比誰都快，逃得也比誰都快。
bio.en: A lackey of the Black Wind Fort, thin as a bamboo pole, who shows two big front teeth whenever he grins. His clothes are patch on patch and a short knife sits at his belt; his eyes dart about for whatever is going cheap. Nobody runs errands faster, and nobody runs away faster either.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 幽冥教的教主，身形清瘦，臉色蒼白，一頭長髮黑如墨，只有一綹雪白。半張臉藏在銀色鬼面之下，深紫長袍，頸上一串白骨念珠，手中白骨扇輕搖。說話總是不急不徐，客客氣氣；聽過他說話的人，大多再也沒說過話。
bio.en: Master of the Netherworld Sect: lean and pale, his long hair ink-black but for one snow-white lock. Half his face is hidden under a silver ghost mask; he wears a deep violet robe and a string of bone beads, and idly waves a fan of white bone. He speaks unhurried and always politely. Most who have heard him speak never spoke again.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.zh: 武林盟副盟主・執法堂主
title.en: Deputy of the Martial Alliance, Master of the Law Hall

bio.zh: 武林盟的副盟主，執掌執法堂。頭戴烏紗、兩撇濃黑八字鬍，一張臉像鐵鑄的，從來不笑；只認證據，不認交情。腰間一條鐵鍊，「鐵鎖連環」一出，沒幾個人走得掉。
bio.en: Deputy of the Martial Alliance and master of its Law Hall. A black official cap, a heavy black moustache and a face like cast iron that never smiles; he trusts proof, never friendship. Few get away once his Iron Lock Chain comes out.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 武林盟的司庫，人稱「金算盤」。圓臉肚子大，瓜皮帽頂一顆紅珠，金珠算盤從不離手，一文一釐都算得清清楚楚。笑起來和氣，談起帳來寸步不讓。
bio.en: Treasurer of the Martial Alliance, known as the Golden Abacus. Round of face and belly, a red bead on top of his melon-skin cap, the gold-beaded abacus always in hand; he accounts for every last copper. Genial when he smiles, immovable when it comes to the books.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 錢萬里身邊的書辦，青衫一領，衣領上總沾著一點墨。說話輕聲細語，開口前先道一聲「失禮了」；帳本抱在胸前，字寫得比誰都工整。
bio.en: Qian Wanli's clerk, in a plain green gown with a spot of ink always on the collar. He speaks softly and begins with “pardon me”; the ledger is always held to his chest, and his hand is the neatest of anyone's.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Apprentice of the Cold River Pavilion

bio.zh: 柳寒煙的小徒弟，兩個圓圓的髮髻綁著紅繩，粉紅衣裳配白領。好奇心比膽子還大，什麼門道都想偷學；也是奕碩在江湖上交到的第一個朋友，兩人一見面就踢起球來。
bio.en: Liu Hanyan's little disciple, two round buns tied with red ribbon, a pink robe with a white collar. Her curiosity is even bigger than her nerve and she wants to learn every trick she sees. Yi Shuo's first friend in the jianghu: the moment they met, they were kicking a ball together.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Master of the Blood Saber Sect

bio.zh: 血刀門的門主，人稱「斷魂刀」。高瘦，白髮向後束起，暗紅長袍，手上一柄血紅的長彎刀。九斬之下不留人，平生最恨一個「輸」字。
bio.en: Master of the Blood Saber Sect, called the Soul-Severing Blade. Tall and gaunt, white hair tied back, a dark red robe and a long curved blade the colour of blood. Nobody is left standing after his nine cuts, and the word he hates most is “lose”.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 住在斷崖下江邊的老漁翁，一頂斗笠、一部白鬍子，左袖空蕩蕩地打了個結。整天只是釣魚，不問名姓；可他看人出刀的眼光，比刀還快。
bio.en: An old fisherman living by the river under the broken cliff: a straw hat, a long white beard, the empty left sleeve tied in a knot. He only fishes and gives no name, yet his eye for a man drawing a blade is quicker than the blade.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 幽冥教的護法，身披血紅尖帽斗篷，臉藏在一張畫著獠牙的白色鬼面後，面具的眼洞裡透著紅光。擋在路中央時一句話也不說。
bio.en: A warden of the Netherworld Sect in a pointed blood-red hood and cloak, his face hidden behind a white ghost mask painted with fangs, red light in its eye holes. When he blocks the road he says nothing at all.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 在天機閣裡等候的人。深紫兜帽，黑布蒙臉，只露出一雙劍眉和眼睛；紫袍滾金邊，出手時掌心泛起紫光。沒有人見過他的真面目。
bio.en: The one who waits in the Stratagem Pavilion: a deep purple hood, black cloth over everything but his sword brows and eyes, a purple robe edged in gold, and a violet glow in his palms when he strikes. Nobody has seen his face.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 斷崖深谷裡的白猿，一身白毛，灰黑的皮臉，雙臂長過膝蓋。守著崖上的朱果，誰伸手就一掌拍下去；認可的人，牠會親手把果子遞過去。
bio.en: A white ape of the gorge under the broken cliff: white fur, a dark leathery face, arms longer than its legs. It guards the red fruit on the cliff and swats any hand that reaches for it; to someone it accepts, it hands the fruit over itself.

habitat.en: The gorge and falls under the broken cliff

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 額頭一個「王」字、雙眼吊梢的大老虎。白天伏在山崗上曬太陽，黃昏才下山找吃的；一聲吼，整片林子的鳥都飛走了。
bio.en: A great tiger with the character for “king” on its brow and slanting eyes. It suns itself on the ridge by day and comes down at dusk to hunt; one roar and every bird in the forest takes flight.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 荒廢古宅門口的石獅子，捲毛鬃、銅鈴眼，口含石珠，座上長滿青苔。白天一動也不動；夜裡有人擅闖，眼睛就亮起紅光。
bio.en: The stone lion at the gate of a ruined mansion: curled mane, bulging eyes, a stone ball in its mouth, moss on its plinth. By day it never moves; when someone trespasses at night, its eyes glow red.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 穿著紫色官服、頭戴官帽的殭屍，額前貼著一張黃符，雙臂直直伸向前，一跳一跳地走。符一掉下來，就再也停不住了。
bio.en: A corpse in a purple official robe and cap with a yellow talisman stuck to its brow, arms stretched straight out, moving in hops. If the talisman falls off, nothing can stop it.

habitat.en: Coffin houses, old tombs and night roads

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 深山裡的山精：一圈金色鬃毛，紅鼻樑、藍色的皺紋臉頰，只有一隻大腳，跳起來卻比人跑得還快。愛偷旅人的鹽和火種，被叫出名字就會逃走。
bio.en: An imp of the deep mountains: a ring of golden mane, a red nose ridge and blue ribbed cheeks, and only one big foot, yet it hops faster than a man can run. It steals travellers' salt and tinder, and flees when called by its name.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 修行千年的金毛狐狸，身後九條尾巴像扇子一樣展開，尾尖燃著雪白的狐火。眼睛細長帶紅，會讓迷路的旅人一直在原地打轉。
bio.en: A golden fox with a thousand years of cultivation, nine tails fanned out behind it, pale fox-fire burning at their tips. Its long red eyes can keep a lost traveller walking in circles all night.

habitat.en: Bamboo groves and old graves on moonlit nights

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 還沒化成龍的蛟，青綠鱗甲、淡黃腹甲，頭上一對短角和長鬚。藏在江心最深的潭底，一翻身就掀起大浪，渡船常被牠攪翻。
bio.en: A jiao that has not yet become a dragon: green-teal scales, a pale yellow belly, two short horns and long whiskers. It hides in the deepest pool mid-river, and when it turns over the waves rise and ferries capsize.

habitat.en: Deep pools and rapids of the great river

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 三隻腳的大火鴉，暗紅羽毛的翅尖燒著火焰，眼睛像燒紅的炭。飛過的地方草木焦黃，乾旱的年頭最常見到牠。
bio.en: A great three-legged crow with dark red plumage and flames at its wingtips, eyes like glowing coals. Grass browns where it flies, and it is seen most in years of drought.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 蹲在沼澤爛泥裡的大毒蟾，比水牛還寬，背上長滿冒著毒漿的黃疣，一雙紅眼睛。嘴角滴著毒涎，噴一口毒霧，十步內的草全枯了。
bio.en: A huge toad squatting in the marsh mud, wider than a water buffalo, its back covered in oozing yellow poison warts, its eyes red. Venom drips from its mouth, and one breath of its poison mist withers the grass for ten paces.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 成群在山林小徑邊游蕩的灰狼，餓了就敢圍住落單的旅人。
bio.en: Grey wolves roam the forest paths in packs and will circle a lone traveller when hungry.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 低頭就衝的山豬，獠牙能把籬笆整排挑翻。
bio.en: A boar that charges head-down; its tusks can toss a whole fence aside.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 藏在竹林裡的小青蛇，綠得跟竹葉分不出來。
bio.en: A small green snake that hides in bamboo, the same colour as the leaves.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 山洞裡倒掛的蝙蝠，一有火光就整群撲出來。
bio.en: Bats that hang in caves and burst out in a swarm at the first light of a torch.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 河岸邊橫著走的大螃蟹，鉗子能夾斷竹竿。
bio.en: A big crab that sidles along the riverbank; its claws can snap a bamboo pole.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 拿樹枝當棍子的山猴，最愛搶旅人的乾糧。
bio.en: A mountain monkey with a stick for a club that loves to snatch travellers' food.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 墳地上飄的藍色鬼火，會跟著人走。
bio.en: A blue ghost-flame over the graves that follows people home.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 武館裡被打了一萬次的木人樁，終於決定還手。
bio.en: A training dummy struck ten thousand times in the martial hall that has finally decided to hit back.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 黑風寨最底層的嘍囉，扛著木棍，嗓門比本事大。
bio.en: The lowest of the Black Wind Fort: a cudgel on his shoulder and a voice bigger than his skill.

habitat.en: Fields and forest paths outside the villages

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 身上一節一節紅黑相間的蛇，咬一口麻半天。
bio.en: A snake banded red and black like a chain; one bite numbs you for half a day.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 拳頭大的虎頭蜂，嗡嗡聲一響，山路上的人都趴下。
bio.en: A hornet as big as a fist; when its buzz comes up the path, everyone drops flat.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 一尺長的紅蜈蚣，從石縫裡直立起來咬人。
bio.en: A red centipede a foot long that rears up out of the rock cracks to bite.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 躲在沙裡只露出尾鉤的蠍子。
bio.en: A scorpion that hides in the sand with only its stinger showing.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 老樹樁成了精，用樹根走路，枝葉一甩就打人。
bio.en: An old stump come alive; it walks on its roots and swats with its branches.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 紫色尖傘的毒菇成了精，傘下垂著一圈菌褶，一跺腳就噴毒粉。
bio.en: A violet, ridged ink-cap mushroom turned imp, a frill of gills under its cap; it stamps and puffs out poison spores.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 還沒長大就入了土的小殭屍，跳起來比大人還快。
bio.en: A jiangshi buried before it could grow up; it hops faster than the grown ones.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 山口的一陣旋風，捲著落葉，笑嘻嘻地掀人帽子。
bio.en: A whirlwind in the mountain pass full of leaves that giggles and steals hats.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 廟門口的三足石蟾，嘴裡含著銅錢，有人偷錢就跳起來。
bio.en: The three-legged stone toad at the temple gate with a coin in its mouth; it leaps at coin thieves.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 黑風寨的老手，棍子上纏著鐵釘。
bio.en: A seasoned Black Wind bandit whose cudgel is wrapped with iron nails.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 躲在山壁上放冷箭的弓手。
bio.en: An archer who hides on the cliff face and looses arrows from cover.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 被逐出寺門的和尚，念珠還掛著，心早就不在了。
bio.en: A monk driven out of his temple; he still wears his beads, but his heart left long ago.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 吃過人血的狼，毛色轉成暗紅，眼睛發黃光，比灰狼凶十倍。
bio.en: A wolf that has tasted human blood; its coat has turned dark red and its eyes glow yellow.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 背上的鬃毛硬得像鐵釘，刀砍下去會冒火星。
bio.en: Its back bristles are as hard as iron nails; a blade striking them throws sparks.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 翅膀泛紅的大蝙蝠，專挑睡著的人下口。
bio.en: A big red-winged bat that only bites people who are asleep.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 金毛發亮的猴王手下，棍法居然有幾分章法。
bio.en: A golden-furred monkey from the ape king's band; its stick work is oddly disciplined.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 出殯用的紙紮人，畫上眼睛以後自己站了起來。
bio.en: A paper funeral effigy that stood up by itself once its eyes were painted on.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 書齋裡打翻的一灘墨，吸了書生的怨氣，到處亂爬。
bio.en: A spilt pool of ink in a study that soaked up a scholar's grudge and now crawls about.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 死在斷崖下的劍客，骨頭還記得怎麼出劍。
bio.en: A swordsman who died under the cliff; his bones still remember how to strike.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 長髮蓋臉、渾身滴水的水鬼，在渡口抓人的腳。
bio.en: A dripping ghost with long hair over its face that grabs ankles at the ferry landing.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 寺裡試武用的銅人，機關一開就擺出拳架。
bio.en: A temple bronze man for testing fighters; trip its mechanism and it takes a stance.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 斗笠垂紗遮住臉的刺客，反手握著短刀。
bio.en: An assassin with a veil hanging from his bamboo hat and a short blade held reversed.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 畫符招鬼的妖道，長鬚飄飄，一臉仙氣，滿肚子壞水。
bio.en: A rogue Daoist who draws charms to summon ghosts: flowing beard, saintly face, a bellyful of mischief.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 殼像鐵甲一樣灰亮的老螃蟹，躲在沼澤的爛泥裡。
bio.en: An old crab whose shell shines grey like armour; it lurks in the marsh mud.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 背上花紋像一張鬼臉的毒蜂，養在古墓的蜂窩裡。
bio.en: A poison hornet whose back is patterned like a ghost face; it nests in old tombs.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 金黃色的大蜈蚣，練毒的人拿牠泡酒。
bio.en: A great golden centipede that poison-masters steep in wine.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 幽冥殿裡點不滅的紫火，碰到就渾身發冷。
bio.en: A purple flame of the Netherworld Hall that never goes out; its touch chills to the bone.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 吸乾了整片林子的枯樹精，葉子全是枯黃色。
bio.en: A withered tree sprite that has drained a whole wood dry; every leaf is dead brown.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 暴雨夜裡打轉的小雷團，碰一下渾身發麻。
bio.en: A little ball of thunder that spins on stormy nights; one touch leaves you numb.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 包了鐵皮的木人，守在高塔的練功房。
bio.en: A dummy sheathed in iron that guards the practice room of the tower.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 血刀門雇來的打手，紅衣黑巾，下手不留情。
bio.en: A thug hired by the Blood Saber Sect, red clothes and black scarf, merciless.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 練鐵頭功練到頭皮發青的惡僧，用頭撞門。
bio.en: A rogue monk who trained his iron-head skill until his scalp turned grey; he opens doors with his head.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 雪峰上的白狼，呼出的氣會結成霜，腳步聲輕得聽不見。
bio.en: A white wolf of the snow peaks whose breath turns to frost and whose steps make no sound.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 漆黑發藍的蠍子，毒一進血就變成墨色。
bio.en: A blue-black scorpion; its venom turns the blood the colour of ink.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 被幽冥教煉過的骷髏，骨頭黑得發亮。
bio.en: A skeleton refined by the Netherworld Sect; its bones shine black.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 寒潭底下的女鬼，經過的水面都會結一層薄冰。
bio.en: A ghost from the bottom of the cold pool; the water she passes skins over with ice.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 穿著陪葬銅甲的小殭屍，刀槍都砍不進。
bio.en: A little jiangshi in the bronze armour it was buried with; blades glance off.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 鍍金的銅人，一拳能把石碑打斷。
bio.en: A gilded bronze man whose fist can break a stone tablet.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 幽冥教的弓手，箭頭塗著冥火。
bio.en: A Netherworld Sect archer whose arrowheads are smeared with nether-fire.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 幽冥教的刺客，紫紗下的眼睛泛著紅光。
bio.en: A Netherworld Sect assassin whose eyes glow red under the violet veil.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 投靠幽冥教的妖道，符紙上畫的全是死人的名字。
bio.en: A rogue Daoist who joined the Netherworld Sect; the charms he draws bear dead men's names.

habitat.en: The Netherworld Hall and the snow peaks

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 擺攤算命的胡半仙，招牌寫著「鐵口直斷，不準不要錢」。他說的話，從來沒有一句準過——所以從來沒收過錢。
bio.en: Hu Banxian tells fortunes under a banner reading "An iron mouth, a sure word, no charge if I'm wrong". Not one of his prophecies has ever come true, so he has never been paid.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 天底下沒有他不賣的東西，連自己的鞋、帽子和外衣都賣了。每次見面，他身上的東西就少一件。
bio.en: There is nothing under heaven he won't sell, his own shoes, hat and coat included. Each time you meet him he is wearing a little less.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 名叫「大膽」，身高八尺、滿臉鬍子，卻是全江湖最膽小的鏢師。一害怕就躲進酒罈，可真到了要緊關頭，總會擋在同伴前面。
bio.en: His name means "Great Courage", he is eight feet tall and bearded, and he is the most timid escort in the jianghu. Frightened, he hides in a wine jar; yet when it matters most he always stands in front of his friends.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 蘇河城的書生，只用對聯說話，一句上聯一句下聯，從不落單。手裡的大毛筆寫得出驚雷。
bio.en: A scholar of Suhe who speaks only in couplets, a first line and a second, never one alone. His great brush can write thunder.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

style_name.en: The Lady Who Forgot She Died

bio.zh: 二十年前死於妖禍的蘇家小姐。她不知道自己已經死了，每天在舊宅裡泡茶，等去京城學馴獸的哥哥回來。
bio.en: The Su daughter, killed in a beast raid twenty years ago. She does not know she is dead; every day she makes tea in the old mansion and waits for her brother, who went to the capital to learn beast-taming.

weapon.en: A round fan and a celadon cup

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 立志要當天下第一劍客的年輕人，在每一座城鎮向奕叡挑戰，每輸一次就在小冊子上記一筆。他不知道自己的父親是誰。
bio.en: A young man set on becoming the greatest swordsman under heaven. He challenges Yi Rui in every town and writes each defeat in a little book. He does not know who his father really is.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

style_name.en: Master of the Hundred Beasts Camp

bio.zh: 百獸山寨的寨主，收留被打醒的妖物。最愛吃肉包，送人四個肉包，到手只剩三個。他的表親在各地客棧當夥計。
bio.en: Master of the Hundred Beasts Camp, where creatures come to their senses. He loves meat buns: he gives you four and you get three. His cousins work at inns everywhere.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 蘇河城的大夫，看病不收錢，說收了也會忘。其實他什麼都記得——他是馭妖宗的藥王鬼手。
bio.en: The doctor of Suhe who treats for free, saying he would only forget the fee. In truth he remembers everything: he is the Beastbinder Sect's Ghost-handed Healer.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 自稱天下第一的大俠，誰做了什麼大事，他就說是自己做的。真打起來，總是被人綁著。
bio.en: A self-styled great hero who claims every deed anyone does. When there is real fighting, he usually ends up tied up.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 馭妖宗的宗主，手持萬妖鈴。二十年前妖禍奪走了他的妹妹，他發誓要讓天下的妖物都聽話。
bio.en: Master of the Beastbinder Sect, bearer of the Bell of Ten Thousand Beasts. A beast raid took his sister twenty years ago, and he swore every creature would obey.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

style_name.en: The Girl Who Talks to Beasts

bio.zh: 青竹寨的苗家姑娘，從小跟狼一起長大，聽得懂妖物說話，卻不太會說人話。
bio.en: A Miao girl of Green Bamboo village who grew up among wolves. She understands creatures, but hardly speaks the human tongue.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 馭妖宗的門徒，腰掛銅鈴，搖一下鈴，身邊的妖物就紅了眼。
bio.en: A disciple of the Beastbinder Sect. One shake of the bell at his belt and every creature nearby sees red.

habitat.zh: 鈴音寺與馭妖宗的據點
habitat.en: The Bell Temple and the sect's strongholds

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 在蘇河水道上打劫的水寇，頭綁白巾，扛著船槳當棍子。
bio.en: A river pirate of the Suhe canals: white head cloth, an oar for a club.

habitat.en: The canal country and Green Wave Cave

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 沼澤裡的泥巴聚成了形，一甩身子就濺得人滿頭泥漿。
bio.en: Swamp mud that has taken a shape. One shake and you're covered head to foot.

habitat.en: The marshes of the canal country and Poison Dragon Marsh

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 在洞穴深處發光的菇妖，孢子讓人昏昏欲睡。
bio.en: A mushroom imp that glows deep in caves; its spores make you drowsy.

habitat.en: Green Wave Cave and the southern wetlands

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 舊宅蓮池裡的女鬼，頭頂荷葉，會唱一首誰也聽不懂的歌。
bio.en: A ghost of an old mansion's lotus pond, a leaf on her head, singing a song no one understands.

habitat.en: The old Su mansion and Green Wave Lake

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 冥婚喜宴上燒剩的紅紙人，咧著嘴笑，跟著鈴聲跳舞。
bio.en: A red paper figure left over from a ghost wedding, grinning and dancing to the bell.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 南疆竹林裡的毒蛇，一圈黑一圈金，咬一口半天走不動。
bio.en: A poisonous snake of the southern bamboo, ringed black and gold.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 竹林裡長了靈性的竹子，會替受傷的妖物療傷。
bio.en: A bamboo stalk that came to life; it tends wounded creatures.

habitat.en: The Bamboo Sea outside Green Bamboo village

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 火山口飛出的紅蜂，翅膀一振就冒火星。
bio.en: Red hornets from the crater; sparks fly when they beat their wings.

habitat.en: Yankou and the Red Flame Caves

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 在熔岩裡爬的螃蟹，殼燒得通紅，會往人身上噴火。
bio.en: A crab that crawls in lava, its shell red-hot; it spits fire.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 毛色像冷掉的熔岩，一張嘴就吐出熱氣。
bio.en: Its coat looks like cooled lava; it breathes out hot air.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 赤焰窟裡的紅蠍，尾針燒得發亮。
bio.en: A red scorpion of the Red Flame Caves; its sting glows.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 馭妖宗的護衛，金邊斗笠下戴著面罩，出手又快又狠。
bio.en: A guard of the Beastbinder Sect: a gold-rimmed hat, a mask, quick and merciless.

habitat.zh: 赤焰窟、冰魄窟與萬妖塔
habitat.en: The Red Flame Caves, the Ice Soul Caves and the tower

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 冰窟裡的蝙蝠，牙齒像冰錐。
bio.en: A bat of the ice caves, teeth like icicles.

habitat.en: The northern snowfields and the Ice Soul Caves

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 北地的白毛猴，最愛偷旅人的乾糧。
bio.en: A white-furred monkey of the north that loves to steal travellers' rations.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 暴風雪裡凝出的精怪，一轉身就捲起一陣雪。
bio.en: A sprite born in a blizzard; it whirls up snow when it turns.

habitat.en: The northern snowfields and the Ice Soul Caves

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 鬃毛結滿冰霜的野豬，衝起來像一座小冰山。
bio.en: A boar whose bristles are thick with frost; it charges like a small iceberg.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 凍在冰窟裡百年的殭屍，被鈴聲吵醒了。
bio.en: A jiangshi frozen in the caves for a century, woken by the bell.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 萬妖塔裡飄蕩的鬼火，隨著鈴聲忽明忽暗。
bio.en: A ghost flame drifting in the tower, flickering with every peal.

habitat.en: The Tower of Ten Thousand Beasts

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 掛滿銅鈴的木偶，由鈴聲牽著動。
bio.en: A wooden puppet hung with brass bells, moved by their ringing.

habitat.en: The Tower of Ten Thousand Beasts

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 骨頭鍍了金的骷髏將軍，守在萬妖塔頂層。
bio.en: A skeleton general with gilded bones, guarding the tower's upper floors.

habitat.en: The Tower of Ten Thousand Beasts

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 通體碧綠的玉蟾，肚子裡全是銀子，一見人就跑。
bio.en: A toad of green jade with a belly full of silver; it runs from anyone.

habitat.en: Now and then in the south and the north

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 馭妖宗的至寶。三魄歸位時，一響能讓天下妖物發狂。
bio.en: The Beastbinder Sect's treasure. With its three souls in place, one peal drives every creature mad.

habitat.en: The Hall of the Bell's Heart, atop the tower

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Abbess of the Mercy Cloud Nunnery

bio.zh: 慈雲庵的住持。白頭巾、灰色長袍、一串紅念珠和一柄拂塵。說話輕聲細語，出手卻從不留情面——對傷人的人。她說：「刀劍無眼，人心有情。」
bio.en: Abbess of the Mercy Cloud Nunnery: a white hood, a grey robe, red prayer beads and a horsetail whisk. She speaks softly and shows no mercy - to those who hurt others. "Blades have no eyes; hearts have feeling."

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 白髮白眉、長鬚過胸，藍袍、金頂禪杖。他教過的弟子，後來都開了自己的門派。
bio.en: White hair and brows, a beard past his chest, a blue robe and a gold-topped staff. Every pupil he taught went on to found a sect.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 赤膊、皮圍裙、一把大鐵鎚。江湖上叫得出名字的好劍，一半出自他的爐子。
bio.en: Bare arms, a leather apron and a great iron hammer. Half the named swords of the jianghu came out of his forge.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 背著包袱、拄著竹杖，走到哪裡就在哪裡立起門派的旗子。包袱裡是師父給的半部秘笈和三天的乾糧。
bio.en: A bundle on his back and a bamboo stick in hand: wherever he stops, a new sect raises its banner. The bundle holds half a manual from his master and three days of dry rations.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 戴著寬邊斗笠，腳程比馬快，看過的山路都記在心裡。一把短刀只用來砍藤蔓。
bio.en: Under a wide straw hat, faster on foot than a horse, he remembers every mountain path he has walked. His short knife is only for cutting vines.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 每天天沒亮就起來紮馬步、練棍法。白頭帶是入門那天師兄綁上的。
bio.en: Up before dawn every day for horse stance and staff drills. A senior brother tied the white headband on him the day he joined.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 紅頭帶、綠衣，背一壺箭。說話不多，開弓之前會先數三下風。
bio.en: Red headband, green robe and a full quiver. Says little; counts the wind three times before every draw.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 棕色短打，一把厚背大刀扛在肩上。刀法不花俏，只求一刀見效。
bio.en: A brown jacket and a thick-backed broadsword on the shoulder. No flourishes: one cut, one result.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 淺藍長衫、白頭帶，長劍出鞘時聲音清得像玉。練劍十年，只為一個「快」字。
bio.en: Pale blue robe and a white headband; his blade leaves the scabbard with a sound as clear as jade. Ten years of practice for one thing: speed.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 灰頭巾、紫衣，袖子裡藏著九枚飛鏢。出手之前，你連他抬手都看不見。
bio.en: Grey hood, violet clothes, nine darts hidden in the sleeves. You will not even see the hand move.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 鐵盔紅甲，紅纓長槍一字排開，騎兵最怕這一排槍尖。
bio.en: Iron helmet, red armour; a row of red-tasselled spears is what horsemen fear most.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: An adept of the inner arts

bio.zh: 白衣長髮，不帶兵器。運起內功時，掌心泛著淡淡的光。
bio.en: White robes, long hair, no weapon. When the inner strength rises, a faint light gathers in the palms.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 藍甲白纓，長劍高舉。七人成陣，進退如一人。
bio.en: Blue armour, white plume, sword held high. Seven make a formation that moves like one.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 青綠甲衣，端著連弩。機括一響，十箭連發。
bio.en: In teal armour with a repeating crossbow levelled: one click and ten bolts fly.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 一頭白髮、灰黑長袍滾金邊，劍負在背上很少出鞘。據說他出鞘的那一劍，沒有人看清楚過。
bio.en: White hair and a dark robe edged in gold; the sword on his back rarely leaves its sheath. They say no one has ever seen the one stroke he draws it for.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

style_name.en: A Golden Bow to Fell Stars

bio.zh: 紅甲金弓，箭能射落天上的流星——至少說書人是這麼說的。
bio.en: Red armour, golden bow; his arrows can bring down a falling star - or so the storytellers say.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 騎一匹棕馬，紅衣皮盔，跑起來像一陣風。肖像是騎手本人，身邊是他的馬。
bio.en: On a brown horse in red with a leather helmet, gone like a gust of wind. The portrait shows the rider with his horse beside him.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 人和馬都披著鐵甲，衝鋒時地面跟著震動。
bio.en: Rider and horse both clad in iron; the ground shakes when they charge.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 一輛蓋著布的鏢車，車上插著紅色鏢旗。肖像是領隊的鏢頭，手裡握著鏢旗。
bio.en: A covered cart flying the red escort banner. The portrait is the escort master who leads it, banner in hand.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 包鐵的巨木架在小屋頂下，推著輪子撞城門。肖像是扛木頭的光頭力士。
bio.en: An iron-capped log slung under a little roof, rolled up to the gate. The portrait is the bald strongman who carries it.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 木架、拋臂和一塊大石頭。肖像是戴圓帽的匠師，手裡掂著下一顆石彈。
bio.en: A timber frame, a throwing arm and a big stone. The portrait is the engineer in a round cap, weighing the next shot.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 滿載火藥桶的車，車頭架著銅火筒。肖像是捧著霹靂彈的火藥師，引信還在冒火星。
bio.en: A cart full of powder kegs with a bronze fire-tube in front. The portrait is the powder master holding a thunder bomb, its fuse still sparking.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 竹篷布帆的小船，在江上穿來穿去。肖像是戴斗笠、扶著槳的船家。
bio.en: A little boat with a matting sail that darts about the river. The portrait is the boatman in a straw hat, oar in hand.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 兩層樓高的戰船，紅柱黑船身，桅頂飄著金旗。肖像是戴鐵盔的船將。
bio.en: A warship two storeys tall, red pillars on a dark hull, a gold banner at the masthead. The portrait is its captain in an iron helmet.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Saber of the Longmen Saber Manor

bio.zh: 深藍衣、藍頭帶，和奕叡一樣背著環首刀。龍門刀莊的弟子出門，總說「第一刀，從腳下開始」。
bio.en: Indigo robe, blue headband and a ring-pommel saber like Yi Rui. Disciples of the Longmen Saber Manor always say: the first cut starts at your feet.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Swordswoman of the Cold River Pavilion

bio.zh: 高髻銀簪、淡藍衣裳，柳寒煙的門下。細劍一出，像江面上的寒煙。
bio.en: A high bun with a silver pin and pale blue robes: one of Liu Hanyan's pupils. Her slim sword moves like mist over a cold river.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Fighting monk of the Thousand Buddha Temple

bio.zh: 光頭、杏黃僧袍、紅袈裟、一串念珠和一根禪杖。站定了，誰也推不動。
bio.en: Shaved head, saffron robe, red kasaya, prayer beads and a ringed staff. Once he plants his feet, no one can move him.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 赤膊、紅褲、金臂環，頭髮像刺蝟。冷笑天的手下，出掌前也學著先冷笑。
bio.en: Bare-chested in red trousers and gold armbands, hair like a hedgehog. One of Leng Xiaotian's men - he too sneers before he strikes.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 紫色兜帽、白骨半面具，眼洞透著紅光。屠千秋的影子。
bio.en: A violet hood and a white bone half-mask with red light in the eyeholes: Tu Qianqiu's shadow.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Tiger rider of the Beastbinder Sect

bio.zh: 綠頭巾、綠衣，騎著一頭被萬妖鈴馴服的猛虎。肖像旁邊就是那頭虎。
bio.en: A green hood and green robes, astride a tiger tamed by the Bell of Ten Thousand Beasts. The tiger is right beside her in the portrait.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Escort master of the House of Qian

bio.zh: 金色鏢車、紅金鏢旗，鏢頭戴著和錢萬里一樣的瓜皮帽。車上的貨每一件都記在帳上。
bio.en: A golden cart and a red-and-gold banner; the escort master wears a melon-skin cap like Qian Wanli's. Every crate on the cart is in the ledger.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

style_name.en: Head of the Black Wind Boys

title.en: Clubman of the Black Wind Fort

bio.zh: 刺蝟頭、一臉黑鬍子、棕色皮背心，扛著釘滿鐵釘的狼牙棒。黑熊說什麼他就做什麼。
bio.en: Spiky hair, a black beard and a brown leather vest, with a nail-studded wolf-tooth club on his shoulder. Whatever Black Bear says, he does.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Saber of the Blood Saber Sect

bio.zh: 暗紅長袍，一把血紅的彎刀。厲寒山的門下，九斬之下不留人。
bio.en: A dark red robe and a blood-red curved blade. A pupil of Li Hanshan: nine cuts, none spared.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Constable of the Hall of Law

bio.zh: 烏紗帽、八字鬍、炭灰長袍，腰間一條鐵鍊。和鐵無私一樣不認交情。
bio.en: Black gauze cap, a stern moustache, a charcoal robe and an iron chain at the waist. Like Tie Wusi, he does not care whose friend you are.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Sword nun of the Mercy Cloud Nunnery

bio.zh: 白頭巾、淡粉衣，劍法柔中帶剛。打完仗，總是第一個替受傷的人包紮。
bio.en: A white hood and pale pink robes; her swordplay is soft with steel inside. After a fight she is always first to bind the wounded.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.zh: 龍門刀莊莊主・兩兄弟的父親
title.en: Master of the Longmen Sabre Manor, father of the brothers

bio.zh: 龍門刀莊的莊主，奕叡和奕碩的父親。灰髮長鬚，深藍長袍，腰間一柄環首刀。把戰旗交給兒子們時，只說了一句：「人在，旗在。」
bio.en: Master of the Longmen Sabre Manor and father of Yi Rui and Yi Shuo: grey hair, a long beard, a deep blue robe and a ring-pommel sabre at his side. When he handed his sons the banner he said only: "While you stand, the banner stands."

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: Banner Steward of the Wulin Alliance

bio.zh: 替武林盟管了十年戰旗的掌旗使。烏紗帽、深紫官服，袖裡藏著飛鏢。每一面旗的針腳他都數過，卻從來不是舉旗的那個人；到了夜裡，他戴上一張白色的鬼面。
bio.en: For ten years he kept the Wulin Alliance's banners: a black gauze cap, a deep violet official's robe, darts up his sleeve. He has counted every stitch of every banner yet was never the one to raise them; by night he wears a white ghost mask.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 綠袍郎中，腰間掛著一個藥葫蘆。金針、湯藥和一點內力，走到哪裡就醫到哪裡。
bio.en: A physician in green with a medicine gourd at the hip. Golden needles, herbs and a little inner strength, healing wherever the road goes.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 青衣高髻的女大夫，藥葫蘆不離身。說話溫和，下針卻又快又準。
bio.en: A woman doctor in teal with her hair in a high bun, never without her medicine gourd. Gentle words, and needles quick and sure.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 紅頭帶、黑短褂，腰裡一把小匕首。手比眼睛快，摸走你的錢袋時還會對你笑。
bio.en: Red headband, black jacket, a little dagger at the waist. Hands faster than eyes; he smiles at you as he lifts your purse.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 黃道袍、髮髻上頂著一頂小金冠，手中一把貼著黃符的桃木劍。火、雷、冰、風四符，蓄氣越久越厲害。
bio.en: A yellow Daoist robe, a little gold crown on the topknot and a peachwood sword with a yellow talisman. Fire, thunder, frost and gale talismans, stronger the longer they are charged.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 藍袍長髮的琴師，懷裡橫抱一張古琴。一曲鼓舞同伴，一曲亂人心神。
bio.en: A long-haired musician in blue holding a qin across his chest. One tune lifts his friends, another scatters the foe's wits.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: A woman player of the qin

bio.zh: 粉衣高髻的琴姬，金簪紅帶，懷抱古琴。
bio.en: A qin maid in pink with a high bun, a gold pin and a red ribbon, a qin in her arms.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 紫色兜帽下一雙細眼，腰間的綠葫蘆裡裝的不是藥。懂醫，也懂毒。
bio.en: Narrow eyes under a purple hood; the green gourd at the waist holds no medicine. Knows healing, and its shadow.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 灰袍黑冠，手搖一把白羽扇。八卦陣守，北斗陣攻。
bio.en: A grey robe, a dark cap and a white feather fan. The Eight Trigrams to guard, the Big Dipper to strike.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 棕袍方巾、山羊鬍，手裡一把紅摺扇。醒木一拍，說得全隊熱血沸騰。
bio.en: A brown robe, a scholar's cap, a goatee and a red folding fan. One clap of the block and the whole company's blood is up.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

bio.zh: 青衫白頭巾，肩上扛著一支比人還長的大毛筆。墨是水，字是風。
bio.en: A teal gown and a white headband, a brush taller than he is on his shoulder. Ink is water; characters are wind.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）

title.en: The quickest hands in the jianghu

bio.zh: 黑兜帽、黑面巾，只露出一雙眼睛。偷東西，也偷武功。
bio.en: A black hood and a black face-cloth, only the eyes showing. Steals things, and steals techniques.

styleName.zh: 8-bit 紅白機（三國志 霸王の大陸風）
